Nested Cross-Validation for Joint Models

Source: R/joint_model.R
nested_cv_joint_model.Rd

Implements two-layer nested cross-validation on an nested_cv object to evaluate the joint model pipeline without tuning leakage.

Usage

nested_cv_joint_model(
  object,
  outcome = survival::Surv(time, status) ~ .,
  subject_id = NULL,
  engine = c("glmnet", "baguette", "stacks"),
  calibration = TRUE,
  parallel = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

object

An rsample::nested_cv object.

outcome

Survival formula with a Surv() outcome.

subject_id

Optional subject identifier column.

engine

Modeling engine: "glmnet", "baguette", or "stacks".

calibration

Logical; whether to calibrate status predictions (default TRUE).

parallel

Logical; whether to run outer splits in parallel.

...

Additional arguments.

Value

An S3 object of class c("nested_cv_joint_model", "tbl_df").

Note

Counting-process Surv(start, stop, event) outcomes are not yet supported here (only in joint_model itself): scoring needs one row per subject, but predictions are one row per interval. Use Surv(time, status) outcomes for cross-validation.
